items.title_orig: Guess the Lines: The Sacking of Troy
items.article_text:
Pearl Jam fades out...
 BILL: All right, we’re taping this late Sunday night. Cousin Sal is here. We gotta talk about this Troy thing.
 SAL: Ugh, do we have to?
 BILL: Historic collapse. You know I’m not a prisoner-of-the-moment guy.
 SAL: Of course not.
 BILL: But that’s one of the five worst home losses ever, right?
 SAL: They were ten-point favorites.
 BILL: I checked seven years in, and the live line was at eleven and a half. They hadn’t lost at home in ten years! This was a Mexico-at-the-Azteca run.
 SAL: And then you lose to a wooden horse.
